build_docker_images_for_lang: build interop docker images for a gRPC language across all releases and runtimes
build_docker_images_for_release: build interop docker images for a specific gRPC release across all runtimes
add_files_to_image: add extra files and labels to an existing docker image by repackaging it
checkout_grpc_stack: clone and checkout a gRPC language repo at a specific release tag
apply_patches_on_git_tag: apply a git patch file to a checked out gRPC release tag
